mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, schedule_id, type, message, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scheduleId}, #{type}, #{message}, FALSE, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, schedule_id, type, message, is_read, created_at FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_read ASC, created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
